description: This file provides PHP4 session management using the ADODB database wrapper library, including encryption for session data and database operations for session handling.

classes.name: MD5Crypt
classes.description: A class used for encrypting and decrypting session data.

methods.name: ADODB_Session_Key
methods.description: Creates an encryption key for crypted sessions using a hardcoded key and session ID.

methods.name: adodb_sess_open
methods.description: Initializes the database connection for session handling.

methods.name: adodb_sess_close
methods.description: Closes the database connection for session handling.

methods.name: adodb_sess_read
methods.description: Reads session data from the database, decrypting it if necessary.

methods.name: adodb_sess_write
methods.description: Encrypts and writes session data into the database.

methods.name: adodb_sess_destroy
methods.description: Removes session data from the database, possibly calling expire notifications.

methods.name: adodb_sess_gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection to remove expired sessions.
